The valley bloomed, teaching that trust multiplied is the greatest magic of all.

When both keepers balanced courage with wisdom—giving enough to spark abundance, returning enough to sustain trust—the springs never ran dry. But the magic demanded participation from both sides; one-sided giving withered like unwatered roots. The valley whispered its truth: mutual flourishing requires mutual commitment.
